about: The shared cases of the MCP server of the publishing tool (issue 41). Both faces read them: apps/plugin/src/publishing/mcp.spec.ts and cli/src/mcp.rs. A case gives one message of the client: an object, or a text when the message is not valid JSON. The test answers it with the server info {"name": "dsebastien-vault-publish", "version": "test"} and with a stand-in for the operations: it records the call that the server makes, and gives the outcome of the case (operation: output, failure and deploy, or error). call is the call that the server must make, or null when it must make none. response is the answer that the server must give, or null when it must give none. In response, the text "<instructions>" stands for the instructions of mcp-tools.json, and "<tools>" for its list of tools.
